supporting_evidence: Portable-container validation already requires contained-item owner identity to match the parent container owner.
All implemented container insertion and ownership-transfer paths recursively preserve a single owner across the container subtree.
A valid parent container with an explicit owner provides one authoritative owner for its descendants.
assumptions: The valid parent container owner is authoritative for all direct contained items.
Recursive validation propagates the corrected owner through nested container levels.
fallback: Reject ownerless parents, missing parents, non-container parents, circular hierarchies, and any state that remains invalid after reconciliation.
runtime_impact: Adds an explicit deterministic recovery operation; normal container mutation rules remain unchanged.
character_save_impact: May normalize stale descendant owner identities to the authoritative parent container owner.
world_state_impact: Does not invent owners for ownerless world or corpse containers.
